notes: Single sheet 'สินค้า' holds a product master with three embedded collections: one price (standard, VAT-inclusive per header), two inventory locations (กรุงเทพ, เชียงใหม่), no promotions column at all — /promotions should be left empty, not fabricated.

Warehouse codes are not present as a code column; the branch names come from the header suffixes of 'คงเหลือ กรุงเทพ' / 'คงเหลือ เชียงใหม่'. If the customer has official warehouse codes they should replace these labels; they are recorded here as straight header text, not as an inferred coding scheme.

VAT: vat_included=true is stated by the header 'ราคาขาย (รวม VAT)'; the VAT rate is not stated anywhere in the file, so use the contract default 0.07 for /prices/*/vat_rate and do not adjust the amount with vat_adjust.
Currency: no currency column exists; the contract default THB plus Thai-language headers and 885 barcodes support THB, but this is a default, not an explicit source statement.

Unit column mixes two facts (unit of measure and pack count) in one string. Canonicalise with unit_normalize and derive /unit/pack_size with pack_size(); 'โหล' (dozen) resolves to DOZEN but its pack size should be treated as 12 only if pack_size() confirms it from the word.

Identifiers: รหัสสินค้า (6 digits) and บาร์โค้ด (13 digits) are numeric in the file; cast both to string so no leading zeros or scientific notation are lost. No zero-padded cells were detected, so no padding should be added.
Status values map cleanly onto the three-value enum; do not also fold สถานะ into attributes.

tables.reason: Single flat sheet, one row per item: unique รหัสสินค้า (12/12 distinct), product name, category, brand, barcode, unit, a VAT-inclusive selling price (ราคาขาย (รวม VAT)) and per-branch stock columns. This is the product master; the price column becomes /prices[0] and the two คงเหลือ columns become /inventory entries.

columns.name: รหัสสินค้า
columns.reason: Header literally 'รหัสสินค้า' (sku synonym); 12 distinct numeric codes, one per row, no nulls. Cast to string to keep it an identifier.

columns.name: ชื่อสินค้า
columns.reason: Header 'ชื่อสินค้า' = product name; unique per row and contains brand+size (e.g. 'น้ำดื่มตราบัว 600 มล.').

columns.name: หมวดหมู่
columns.reason: Header 'หมวดหมู่' = category; 3 values (เครื่องดื่ม 5, ของใช้ในบ้าน 4, อาหารแห้ง 3). Only one level exists, so emit a single-element array.

columns.name: ยี่ห้อ
columns.reason: Header 'ยี่ห้อ' = brand; 8 distinct short Thai brand words (บัว, ทุ่งทอง, ใบชา, ดอยฟ้า …).

columns.name: บาร์โค้ด
columns.reason: Header 'บาร์โค้ด'; all 12 values are 13-digit EAN-13 style numbers starting 885 (Thailand prefix 885). Must be read as text, not a numeric to avoid scientific notation.

columns.name: หน่วย
columns.reason: Header 'หน่วย' = unit of measure; 6 distinct Thai unit strings (ขวด, แพ็ค 6, ชิ้น, ลัง(24), กล่อง, โหล). Use unit_normalize to canonicalise to the enum (BOTTLE, PACK, PCS, CARTON, BOX, DOZEN).

columns.name: หน่วย
columns.reason: Same column carries packing counts inside the unit text ('แพ็ค 6' → 6, 'ลัง(24)' → 24, 'โหล' → 12); derive with pack_size(). No separate column exists.

columns.name: ราคาขาย (รวม VAT)
columns.reason: Header explicitly states 'ราคาขาย (รวม VAT)' = selling price VAT included, so amount is the cell value unchanged and vat_included=true; 12 distinct values 7–336, no nulls. Single price column therefore a single-element /prices array with price_list 'standard' (no price-group column in the file).

columns.name: สถานะ
columns.reason: Header 'สถานะ'; exactly 3 values matching the enum: ขาย (10) → active, ไม่ขาย (1) → inactive, เลิกขาย (1) → discontinued.

columns.name: คงเหลือ กรุงเทพ
columns.reason: Header 'คงเหลือ <สาขา>' = remaining stock at a branch; 12 distinct integers 0–480. The header suffix 'กรุงเทพ' is the warehouse/branch name → warehouse_code 'Bangkok' for this inventory entry.

columns.name: คงเหลือ เชียงใหม่
columns.reason: Second branch stock column, same pattern; 12 distinct integers 4–120. Header suffix 'เชียงใหม่' → warehouse_code 'Chiang Mai'; emit as a second /inventory element per SKU, not as a separate field.

tables.key_column: รหัสสินค้า

open_questions: The file has no warehouse-code column; /inventory/*/warehouse_code currently carries the Thai branch labels from the stock headers (กรุงเทพ, เชียงใหม่). If the customer uses official warehouse codes, those should be supplied.
VAT rate is not stated anywhere in the file; /prices/*/vat_rate is left to the schema default 0.07 rather than asserted from the data.
สถานะ is mapped as ขาย→active, ไม่ขาย→inactive, เลิกขาย→discontinued. If 'ไม่ขาย' is meant as permanently delisted rather than temporarily inactive, that value should be discontinued instead.
'โหล' (dozen) is normalised to DOZEN and pack_size() derives 12; if the customer treats a dozen as a selling unit with pack size 1, /unit/pack_size for those rows should be adjusted.
changes_from_draft: Added /inventory collection: the two คงเหลือ branch columns are now emitted as two inventory items per SKU via a new unpivoted source 'stock' (previously the columns were unmatched and only landed in /attributes).
/sku and /barcode now cast to string and strip a trailing '.0' instead of a plain trim, preserving the 6-digit code and the 13-digit EAN length.
/status no longer uses keep_unmapped:true, so an unseen Thai status cannot emit an out-of-enum string.
/unit/sell_unit now uses an explicit Thai→enum map with unit_normalize as fallback, keeping 'แพ็ค 6' and 'ลัง(24)' deterministic.
Added /prices/*/vat_rate? No — left unmapped so the schema default 0.07 applies (rate not stated in the file).
Record dedupe keys set to /sku; added quality rules for /inventory qty range, status enum and barcode pattern.
/promotions intentionally not created: no promotion columns exist in the file.

notes: Table 0 covers three entity groups at once: product masters (Code, Description, Group, Make, EAN, Status), one price point (Price (incl. VAT)) and two inventory rows (Qty BKK, Qty CNX).
EAN and Code are numeric in the sheet and must be cast to string (EAN exactly 13 digits) to avoid numeric coercion in /sku and /barcode.

Price column header explicitly states VAT is included, so /prices/*/vat_included = true with vat_rate 0.07 is evidenced by the header text; currency THB is the contract default and is not printed in the file.
Warehouse codes BKK and CNX are derived from the column headers ('Qty BKK', 'Qty CNX'), not from any cell value — the file has no explicit warehouse code column.
UoM mixes pure units (BTL, PCS, BOX, DZ) with pack-qualified codes (PACK 6, CTN 24); unit_normalize plus pack_size should split sell unit from pack quantity.
Table 1 must not be loaded as product rows; it is a reference dictionary for mapping Status A→active, I→inactive, D→discontinued.

tables.reason: Sheet 'Items' has one row per product: a unique numeric Code (100101…300104), a unique Description (product names such as 'Bua Water 600ml'), a unique 13-digit EAN, a brand ('Make' in Thai), a product Group, a VAT-inclusive unit price, a UoM and two per-branch stock columns. This is the master product list that carries embedded price, unit and inventory data.

columns.name: Code
columns.reason: Header 'Code', unique per row (12/12 distinct), 6-digit article numbers (100101, 200101, 300101) matching product numbering conventions. Stored as int in the file, so it must be cast to string for /sku.

columns.name: Description
columns.reason: Unique per row and contains full sellable names with pack size ('Bua Water 600ml', 'Thungthong Jasmine Rice 5kg'), i.e. the customer-facing product name rather than a long description.

columns.name: Group
columns.reason: Only 3 broad values (Beverages, Household, Dry Food) repeated across products — a single-level product group -> one-element category array.

columns.name: Make
columns.reason: Thai manufacturer/brand words (บัว, ทุ่งทอง, ใบชา, ดอยฟ้า) that prefix the product names (Bua Water, Thungthong Jasmine Rice); 8 distinct brands over 12 products fits brand, not category.

columns.name: EAN
columns.reason: Header 'EAN', 13-digit values starting 885 (Thailand GS1 prefix), unique per row. Must be cast to string to keep the full 13 digits.

columns.name: Price (incl. VAT)
columns.reason: Header explicitly states 'Price (incl. VAT)' and values look like retail selling prices (7, 14, 39, 336). Single price column → one price_list, and vat_included=true is stated by the header itself, vat_rate default 0.07 from contract.

columns.name: UoM
columns.reason: Unit codes (BTL, PACK 6, PCS, CTN 24, BOX, DZ) require unit_normalize; the embedded counts ('PACK 6', 'CTN 24') also supply /unit/pack_size via pack_size().

columns.name: Qty BKK
columns.reason: Non-negative integer quantities (0–480) under a branch-qualified header, i.e. stock on hand at the Bangkok branch; the warehouse code BKK is implied by the column header, not by cell values.

columns.name: Qty CNX
columns.reason: Second branch quantity column (4–120) for Chiang Mai; same quantity semantics as Qty BKK, separate inventory entry with warehouse code CNX derived from the header.

columns.name: Status
columns.reason: Single-letter lifecycle codes (A=10 rows, I=1, D=1) that match exactly the code list on the 'Codes' sheet (A=Active, I=Inactive, D=Discontinued), so it must be mapped through that lookup and not guessed.

tables.key_column: Code

tables.reason: Small 3-row reference/lookup sheet: 'Status' code contains A, I, D and 'Meaning' contains Active, Inactive, Discontinued. It holds no products, prices or stock — it is the code dictionary used to interpret table 0's Status column.

columns.name: Status
columns.reason: Code column (A/I/D) of the status dictionary; used as the lookup key when decoding Items.Status, not as a status value by itself.

columns.name: Meaning

columns.name: รหัส
columns.reason: Header 'รหัส' matches sku synonym; 12 unique values (100101..300104) formatted as item codes. Must be read as text so leading characters/zeros are preserved, not as int.

columns.name: ชื่อสินค้า

columns.name: ยี่ห้อ
columns.reason: Header 'ยี่ห้อ' is the Thai synonym for brand; short brand tokens (บัว, ทุ่งทอง, ใบชา ...) repeat across items.

columns.name: บาร์โค้ด
columns.reason: Header 'บาร์โค้ด' is the barcode synonym; 13-digit EAN values, unique per row. Stored as int in the sheet, so the target string must be produced without scientific notation and without losing digits.

columns.name: หน่วย
columns.reason: Header 'หน่วย' = unit of measure; values (ขวด, ชิ้น, กล่อง, โหล, แพ็ค 6, ลัง(24)) are sell units. Some values embed a pack multiplier ('แพ็ค 6', 'ลัง(24)') which also informs /unit/pack_size; unit_normalize to the schema enum hint plus pack_size extraction is needed, so confidence is below that of pure text fields.

columns.name: ราคา (รวม VAT)
columns.reason: Header 'ราคา (รวม VAT)' is the selling price with VAT explicitly included; single price list for all rows, values 7–336 THB, none empty. Header supplies vat_included=true evidence for /prices/*/vat_included and implies price_list default 'standard'; no effective dates in the sheet.

columns.name: สถานะ
columns.reason: Header 'สถานะ' (status) with 3 values: ขาย 10, ไม่ขาย 1, เลิกขาย 1 — maps to active / inactive / discontinued. Numeric ratio small and semantics clear, but mapping is by convention, so 0.85.

columns.name: section

notes: Single-table export: no inventory columns (no warehouse or on-hand quantity) and no promotion columns (no discount %, promo price, or validity dates), so only /prices is populated from this file.
Currency is not present in the file; the contract's default THB is assumed for /currency — not evidenced by any cell in this export.

VAT inclusion is evidenced by the header 'ราคาขาย (รวม VAT)', so /prices/*/vat_included = true. The VAT rate itself is not stated anywhere in the file; the schema default 0.07 would be an assumption, not a source fact.

The หน่วย values 'แพ็ค 6' and 'ลัง(24)' carry the pack count in parentheses/label, while 'ขวด', 'ชิ้น', 'กล่อง' and 'โหล' carry no explicit count — a null pack_size for those is a source gap, not zero.
บาร์โค้ด and รหัสสินค้า are typed as numbers in the CSV; both must be emitted as strings to preserve the full digit sequences.
tables.reason: Sheet PRODUCT_EXPORT holds one row per item (12 rows, 8 columns) with a unique product code, name, category, brand, barcode, selling unit and a single selling price plus a sell status. No warehouse/on-hand columns (so not inventory) and no promo/discount/date columns (so not promotions); the single price column makes it a product master with one embedded standard price rather than a price-list table.

columns.name: รหัสสินค้า
columns.reason: Thai header รหัสสินค้า is an exact synonym of sku; 12 distinct values for 12 rows (unique_ratio 1.0), values 100101–300104 look like internal item codes. Read as text to keep the digits intact.

columns.name: ชื่อสินค้า
columns.reason: Thai header ชื่อสินค้า = product name; one distinct descriptive value per row (e.g. 'น้ำดื่มตราบัว 600 มล.', 'ข้าวหอมมะลิทุ่งทอง 5 กก.') with size/pack text embedded — this is the display name, not a separate spec field.

columns.name: หมวดหมู่
columns.reason: Thai header หมวดหมู่ = category; only 3 distinct single-level values (เครื่องดื่ม 5, ของใช้ในบ้าน 4, อาหารแห้ง 3). No parent/child separator in the values, so the category array will contain exactly one level.

columns.name: ยี่ห้อ
columns.reason: Thai header ยี่ห้อ = brand; 8 distinct short brand words (บัว, ทุ่งทอง, ใบชา, ดอยฟ้า …), consistent with the brand token already appearing inside the product names.

columns.name: บาร์โค้ด
columns.reason: Thai header บาร์โค้ด = barcode; 12 distinct 13-digit values starting with 885 (Thailand GS1 prefix), unique per row. Stored numerically by the export, so it must be cast to a string without a decimal part (8850001000011, never 8.850001000011E12).

columns.name: หน่วย
columns.reason: Thai header หน่วย = sales unit; distinct values ขวด (5), แพ็ค 6 (2), ชิ้น (2), ลัง(24), กล่อง, โหล — these map to BOTTLE, PACK, PCS, CARTON, BOX, DOZEN. Two values embed a pack count ('แพ็ค 6', 'ลัง(24)'), which also feeds /unit/pack_size.

columns.name: ราคาขาย (รวม VAT)
columns.reason: Thai header ราคาขาย = selling price and the header explicitly states รวม VAT (VAT included); 12 distinct non-null values 7.00–336.00 with sen decimals (59.50). Single price column with no list/channel/validity columns, so it becomes one price entry with price_list 'standard', vat_included = true, and the pack count in หน่วย also explains the higher values (e.g. 336.00 for a case).

columns.name: สถานะ
columns.reason: Thai header สถานะ = status; 3 distinct values ขาย (10), ไม่ขาย (1), เลิกขาย (1) mapping onto the contract enum active / inactive / discontinued respectively.

tables.key_column: รหัสสินค้า

open_questions: The file never states the VAT rate; /prices/*/vat_rate is left unmapped so the schema default 0.07 applies — confirm if a different rate is in force.
Only แพ็ค 6 and ลัง(24) embed a pack quantity; ขวด, ชิ้น, กล่อง and โหล give none (โหล implies 12 but is not spelled out numerically), so /unit/pack_size is null for those rows.
หมวดหมู่ has a single level only; if a parent/child category hierarchy exists in another system it is not present in this export.
changes_from_draft: Cast รหัสสินค้า and บาร์โค้ด to string and strip the trailing .0 — they are read as numeric and would otherwise lose their printed form (barcode must stay 13 digits).
Status mapping no longer uses keep_unmapped; only the three observed Thai values map to the enum so an unseen status becomes null instead of an out-of-enum string.
Unit sell_unit now uses an explicit map for the pack-qualified values (แพ็ค 6 → PACK, ลัง(24) → CARTON) with unit_normalize as fallback, instead of unit_normalize alone.
Category wrapped as normalize_whitespace then to_list for a clean single-element path.
Price collection deduped on /price_list and record dedupe set to /sku (schema identity key).
Added a barcode format quality rule and left /prices/*/vat_rate unmapped rather than inventing a rate.

ไม่มีการระบุว่าคอลัมน์ 'ราคาโปร' รวม VAT หรือไม่ และ schema ของ promotions ไม่มีฟิลด์ vat_included จึงส่งค่าตามต้นฉบับ
คอลัมน์ 'หน่วย' รวมหน่วยและจำนวนต่อแพ็คไว้ด้วยกัน ('แพ็ค 6', 'ลัง(24)', 'โหล') ระบบแยกเป็น sell_unit (PACK/CARTON/DOZEN) และ pack_size ตามข้อความในเซลล์ ไม่ได้อนุมานจากพฤติกรรมการค้า
changes_from_draft: แก้ /sku และ /barcode: คอลัมน์ถูกอ่านเป็นตัวเลข (int) จึง cast เป็น string แล้วตัด '.0' ต่อท้าย เพื่อไม่ให้รหัสและบาร์โค้ด 13 หลักเสียรูป (draft ใช้เพียง trim/normalize_whitespace)
แก้ /status: เอา keep_unmapped ออก เพื่อไม่ให้สถานะภาษาไทยที่ไม่รู้จักหลุดเป็นค่า خارج enum
แก้ /unit/sell_unit: ใช้ map_values แบบระบุค่าครบ (ขวด→BOTTLE, แพ็ค 6→PACK, ชิ้น→PCS, ลัง(24)→CARTON, กล่อง→BOX, โหล→DOZEN) แล้ว fallback ด้วย unit_normalize สำหรับหน่วยที่จะเพิ่มภายหลัง
แก้ /unit/pack_size: ครอบ normalize_whitespace ก่อน pack_size ให้สอดคล้องกับคอลัมน์เดียวกัน

แก้ /promotions/*/type: เปลี่ยนจาก fuzzy+keep_unmapped เป็น map เต็มค่าที่ไม่ fuzzy ครอบทั้ง 4 ค่าที่พบ (ลด% / ลดบาท / ซื้อแถม / ราคาพิเศษ) เพราะ 'ลดบาท' มีคำว่า 'ลด' อยู่ ทำให้ fuzzy ขึ้นกับลำดับคีย์
เพิ่ม cast to int ให้ /promotions/*/buy_qty และ /promotions/*/get_qty ตามชนิด integer ของ schema
เพิ่ม /prices/*/vat_rate = 0.07 (ค่า default ของ schema) พร้อมความเชื่อมั่นต่ำและบันทึกเป็น open question
ปรับ /promotions/*/start_date และ end_date เป็น assume_year 'auto' + dayfirst true เพราะคอลัมน์เดียวกันมีทั้งปี พ.ศ. (2569, 69) และ ค.ศ. (2026, 26)
เพิ่ม filter not_null บนคีย์ join ของ collection /prices และ dedupe ของ record ที่ /sku
เพิ่ม quality rule not_null ของ /sku และ enum ของ /promotions/*/type

notes: Only one sheet ('ราคา') and one detected table, with 0 formula or error cells; no inventory quantities, warehouses, promotions, or date ranges are present anywhere in the file.

Column 'ราคา' is a single standard price; no price-list/channel column exists. The workbook name 'ราคาก่อนภาษี' is the only evidence for VAT treatment, so /prices/*/vat_included should be false (pre-VAT). /prices/*/vat_rate is not stated in any cell and should stay null rather than being inferred, since the schema default 0.07 is a fallback, not source evidence.
No currency column exists; /currency is only supportable via the schema default THB (Thai-language product data, ฿-scale prices), so it should be treated as a default rather than a confirmed fact.
'รหัสสินค้า' and 'บาร์โค้ด' are typed as integers by the reader; both must be cast to text so the 13-digit barcode and any leading zeros survive unchanged.

The 'หน่วย' column combines unit and pack size, e.g. 'แพ็ค 6' and 'ลัง(24)'; unit_normalize should yield the sell unit (PACK/CARTON) while pack_size extracts 6 and 24 respectively. Plain 'ขวด', 'ชิ้น', 'กล่อง', 'โหล' carry no pack quantity and should give pack_size null.
Column 'ชื่อสินค้า' contains pack wording ('แพ็ค 6') that duplicates the unit column; it is descriptive product text and should not be parsed into pack size.
Columns 'หมวดหมู่' and 'ยี่ห้อ' have no dedicated description/note column, so /description and /attributes remain empty for this file.

tables.reason: Single flat product-master sheet: one row per unique product with a unique SKU (รหัสสินค้า, 12 distinct / 12 rows), a product name, category, brand, 13-digit EAN barcode, a selling unit, a single VAT-inclusive selling price and a sale status. No warehouse/stock columns (→ not inventory), no promo columns (→ not promotions), no date/price-list columns (→ price is an attribute of the product row, so the sheet is the products table).

columns.name: รหัสสินค้า
columns.reason: Header literally 'รหัสสินค้า' = product code (a listed sku synonym); 12 distinct values for 12 rows, unique ratio 1.0, values 100101–300104 in the pattern of a товарный code. Field is typed string in the contract, so it must be cast to text to preserve the exact code.

columns.name: ชื่อสินค้า
columns.reason: Header 'ชื่อสินค้า' = product name (exact contract synonym); 12 distinct free-text Thai descriptions such as 'น้ำดื่มตราบัว 600 มล.' and 'ข้าวหอมมะลิทุ่งทอง 5 กก.'.

columns.name: หมวดหมู่
columns.reason: Header 'หมวดหมู่' = category; only 3 distinct values (เครื่องดื่ม 5, ของใช้ในบ้าน 4, อาหารแห้ง 3). It is a single flat level, so it maps to the one-element array /category (no sub-category column exists in the sheet).

columns.name: ยี่ห้อ
columns.reason: Header 'ยี่ห้อ' = brand (exact contract synonym); 8 distinct brand names (บัว, ทุ่งทอง, ใบชา, ดอยฟ้า, …) repeated across products, matching the brand segment inside the product names.

columns.name: บาร์โค้ด
columns.reason: Header 'บาร์โค้ด' = barcode; 12 distinct 13-digit values starting with 885 (Thailand GS1 prefix, valid EAN-13 shape). Contract type is string, so the numeric cells must be cast to text without altering digits.

columns.name: หน่วย
columns.reason: Header 'หน่วย' = unit of measure; values ขวด (5), แพ็ค 6 (2), ชิ้น (2), ลัง(24), กล่อง, โหล combine a sell unit with an embedded pack quantity. This one column feeds both /unit/sell_unit (via unit_normalize, e.g. ขวด→BOTTLE, ลัง(24)→CARTON, แพ็ค 6→PACK, โหล→DOZEN, ชิ้น→PCS, กล่อง→BOX) and /unit/pack_size (ลัง(24)→24, แพ็ค 6→6, โหล→12, single units→1).

columns.name: ราคาขาย (รวม VAT)
columns.reason: Header 'ราคาขาย (รวม VAT)' = selling price, VAT included — explicit source evidence for both meaning and VAT inclusion; 12 distinct non-null numeric amounts 7–336. It becomes a single-element /prices entry with amount = cell value, vat_included = true (as stated by the header), price_list = 'standard' (no price-list/channel column exists) and vat_rate 0.07 from the schema default (Thai standard rate), to be stated explicitly rather than inferred.

columns.name: สถานะ
columns.reason: Header 'สถานะ' = status; 3 distinct values ขาย (10) / ไม่ขาย (1) / เลิกขาย (1) map onto the contract enum active / inactive / discontinued (เลิกขาย is an exact contract synonym for discontinued).

open_questions: Currency is not present in the sheet; /currency uses the schema default THB — confirm if a different currency applies.
/unit/pack_size is derived from the unit text (แพ็ค 6→6, ลัง(24)→24, โหล→12); plain units (ขวด, ชิ้น, กล่อง) yield null — confirm whether single units should be recorded as pack_size 1 instead.
/prices/*/price_list is set to 'standard' because no price-list column exists — confirm if these prices belong to a named price list or channel.

Removed keep_unmapped from the /status map_values so unseen Thai statuses become null instead of an out-of-enum string.
Added /prices/*/vat_rate = 0.07 (schema default) alongside vat_included = true.
Added record dedupe on /sku and /prices dedupe key /price_list.
Added quality rules for /sku not_null and a 13-digit barcode shape check.
Kept /currency = THB as the contract default and raised it as an open question.

open_questions: No VAT rate is stated anywhere in the workbook; /prices/*/vat_rate is left unset so the contract default 0.07 applies. If this customer's prices embed a different rate, /prices/*/amount cannot be safely restated.
The promotion start/end dates are identical for all four rows (2026-10-01 … 2026-10-31); if per-promotion windows exist elsewhere they are not in this export.

Unit strings 'แพ็ค 6' and 'ลัง(24)' are treated as one sell unit of 6 / 24 pieces; if these products are actually sold by the inner piece from some channel, /prices would need a per-channel price list — no such column exists.
changes_from_draft: Kept the three sources, the root source 'products' and all collection links — they match the sheet roles and keys.

Rebound each source by sheet name (สินค้า / โปรโมชั่น / stock) instead of file-name patterns '^products' / '^stock' / '^promotions', because the stock and product sheets were seen inside the same workbook file; a missing stock.xlsx would otherwise drop the whole inventory collection.
/sku and /barcode: replaced trim/normalize_whitespace on an int-typed column with cast→string plus regex_replace of a trailing '.0', so the 6-digit SKU and 13-digit EAN keep their exact digits.
/unit/sell_unit: added an explicit map for the six observed unit strings (ขวด, แพ็ค 6, ชิ้น, ลัง(24), กล่อง, โหล) with unit_normalize kept only as fallback.
/unit/pack_size: added (missing from the draft) — parsed from the quantity embedded in 'หน่วย' (6, 24, 12), null for plain units.
/status: removed keep_unmapped so an unseen Thai status becomes null instead of a value outside the target enum.
/promotions/*/type: removed keep_unmapped (kept fuzzy) so an unseen promotion type cannot escape the contract enum.
/promotions/*/discount_amount: raised confidence from 0.78 to 0.92 — the distinct check confirms a single value 5 that sits exactly on the ลดบาท row alongside its promo type.
Added /prices and /inventory collection identity-key dedupe (/price_list, /warehouse_code) and /promo_code for promotions, plus record dedupe on /sku.
Added quality rules: SKU unique/not-null as errors, positive price/stock, EAN regex and enum checks as warnings.
Left empty benefit cells (75% of the discount/price/buy/get columns) as null — they are type-specific by design and are not zero-filled.

columns.name: Art No

columns.name: Descr
columns.reason: 'Descr' holds human-readable item names such as 'Bua Water 600ml', 'Thungthong Jasmine Rice 5kg', 'Tom Yum Instant Noodles' — unique per row and clearly the display name, not a long specification text.

columns.name: Grp
columns.reason: 'Grp' takes only 3 values (Beverages 5, Household 4, Dry Food 3) — a single-level product group. Maps to /category as a one-element array; no narrower sub-category exists in this file.

columns.name: Mfr
columns.reason: 'Mfr' = manufacturer, with Thai brand names (บัว, ทุ่งทอง, ใบชา, ดอยฟ้า, นุ่มนวล …) repeated across articles — matches the brand/manufacturer semantic of the contract.

columns.name: EAN
columns.reason: 'EAN' values are 13-digit codes starting with 885 (Thailand GS1 prefix), one per article, all distinct → EAN-13 barcode. Must be emitted as text, not number.

columns.name: UoM

columns.name: Qty/Pk

columns.name: Unit Prc
columns.reason: 'Unit Prc' is a single never-empty numeric price per article (7–336), unique per row → the unit selling price. It becomes one /prices entry per article with price_list 'standard' (no price-list column exists) and vat_included taken from the adjacent VAT In column.

columns.name: VAT In
columns.reason: 'VAT In' is an explicit Y/N flag on the price row; all 12 rows are 'Y', so the unit prices are stated by the source as VAT-inclusive. This is direct source evidence, not an inferred retail convention.

columns.name: Stat
columns.reason: 'Stat' has 3 codes: A (10 rows), I (1), D (1) — a typical SAP article status (Active / Inactive-blocked / Deletion-flagged). Mapping A→active, I→inactive, D→discontinued is inferred from single-letter ERP convention and should be confirmed.

Unit column mixes sell units and embedded pack sizes ('แพ็ค 6', 'ลัง(24)', 'โหล'), so /unit/pack_size should be derived from these values where present; the standalone unit values carry no pack quantity.
Identifiers (รหัสสินค้า, บาร์โค้ด) are numeric in the file; they must be cast to text so leading zeros and full barcode length are preserved.

Replaced the raw unit_normalize call with an explicit map for the six observed units plus unit_normalize fallback, and kept pack_size parsing (6, 24, 12).
Mapped /status explicitly for ขาย/ไม่ขาย/เลิกขาย and omitted keep_unmapped so unexpected values become null instead of invalid enum values.
Kept attributes_passthrough true to preserve raw root columns; structured prices are also emitted under /prices.
Set /prices/*/vat_included to provisional true with low confidence and added a clarification because the file has no VAT marker.
Added record dedupe on /sku and quality rules for required price fields.
